name: TubeHaus
description: Your own YouTube for the whole household, without ads, tracking or a Google account.
longDescription:
TubeHaus is a YouTube app you host yourself. It looks and feels like YouTube, but there are no ads, no tracking and no account with Google: your subscriptions, history, playlists and resume points live on your own server, and every phone, computer and TV in the house sees the same library.

It asks YouTube itself (TubeHaus' own engine), so nothing else needs to be installed: no Invidious, no database. The app is two containers: the server and the web app with its Caddy router.

  • Up to 4K, SponsorBlock, chapters, captions and translated subtitles
  • Live streams with live captions transcribed on your server (whisper.cpp)
  • Send to TV, and watch together in a room that keeps everyone on the same moment
  • Offline save, a music mode with lyrics, and a big-screen mode for TVs
  • Calm mode: a home screen of only your subscriptions, with Shorts, trending, recommendations and autoplay turned off

Everyone who can open the address shares one library by default; tick "separate accounts" to give each person their own. Independent open-source software (AGPL-3.0), not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
